hints.tr: Her kayıt bir sözlük; şehri `record["city"]` veriyor.
hints.en: Each record is a dictionary; `record["city"]` gives the city.

hints.tr: Liste üreteciyle tek satırda yazabilirsin: `[record["city"] for record in records]`.
hints.en: A list comprehension does it in one line: `[record["city"] for record in records]`.

hints.tr: Tekrarsız şehirler için kümeye çevir: `set(cities)`. Küme aynı değeri iki kez tutmuyor, saymak için `len` yeter.
hints.en: For the distinct cities turn it into a set: `set(cities)`. A set never holds the same value twice, so `len` is enough to count them.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
cities = [record["city"] for record in records]

print(cities)
print(len(set(cities)))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
cities = [record["city"] for record in records]

print(cities)
print(len(set(cities)))
```
